A chart illustrating the four main postures of Salah. Left to right: 1. Qiyām (a person standing upright with right hand folded over left on the chest), 2. Rukū' (the person bowing at a 90-degree angle, hands resting on knees, back straight), 3. Sujūd (the person prostrating on the floor with forehead, nose, palms, knees, and toes touching the ground), 4. Julūs (the person sitting on their legs with hands resting on thighs). Labels below each: "Qiyām (Standing)", "Rukū' (Bowing)", "Sujūd (Prostration)", "Julūs (Sitting)".
